# Generate social videos with AI avatars using VEED and Claude

## How it works
1. Configure your topic, intention, and API keys
2. Claude generates script, image prompt, and caption
3. OpenAI creates avatar image and voiceover audio
4. VEED renders lip-synced talking-head video
5. Video saved to Google Drive, metadata logged to Sheets

## Setup steps
1. Add your Anthropic and OpenAI API keys in the Configuration node
2. Connect FAL.ai credential to VEED node
3. Connect Google Drive and Sheets OAuth2 credentials
4. Set your Drive folder and Sheets URLs
5. Customize topic, brand, and audience settings

### Configuration
Set your topic, API keys, and video settings. Supports custom avatar descriptions and scripts.

### AI Content Generation
Claude creates the script, image prompt, and social caption based on your topic and intention.

### Avatar & Audio
OpenAI generates a photorealistic avatar image and converts the script to natural speech.

### Video Rendering
VEED creates the final lip-synced talking-head video from your avatar and audio.

### Storage & Logging
Downloads the video, uploads to Google Drive, and logs all metadata to Google Sheets.
